description: Track physical emissions explicitly before policy credits are applied
caveat: Requires consistent emissions architecture from Wave D
notes: Foundation for all later carbon policy

description: Apply gross ETS cost visibly in the objective
required_inputs: Physical emissions and EUA price time series
caveat: Base-policy candidate and not yet an approved numeric table

description: Represent free allocation as a separate explicit credit module
required_inputs: Allocation logic and benchmark or activity inputs
caveat: Needs site-specific allocation evidence and careful review
notes: Must not be hidden in emissions factors

description: Report net ETS cost ex post as gross cost minus separate credit
required_inputs: Gross ETS and separate free-allocation module
caveat: Only meaningful once both components are explicit
notes: Useful for policy reporting not for shortcut modelling

description: Keep CBAM outside the base objective and reserve it for a later trade or market module
caveat: Do not add CBAM as a direct cost on EU output

description: Keep indirect electricity emissions as reporting-only unless a later design explicitly activates them
required_inputs: Electricity import and optional reporting factor
caveat: Not equivalent to direct ETS exposure

description: Forbid net emissions-factor shortcuts that hide gross ETS cost and free allocation inside one number
caveat: Governance rule rather than numeric input

description: Do not assume automatic ETS revenue or surplus sale in the base case
caveat: Surplus logic would require separate explicit policy and allowance treatment
